newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight, one-week rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight, one-week rates fall.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell to between 9-3/4 and 10-1/8 percent on Wednesday from Tuesday's range of 10-1/8 and 10-1/4 percent in a liquid private sector market, bankers said.
One-week rates also fell to between 9-7/8 and 10-1/16 percent from 10-1/4 and 10-3/8 percent on Tuesday.
Bankers said the central bank injected liquidity into the market via a 500 million pounds repo deal.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent.
